comment_optionalDependencies: Build/test toolchain is intentionally in optionalDependencies, not devDependencies. GoDaddy PaaS forces a full install and its sandbox cannot execute esbuild's binary (postinstall EACCES). As optional deps, that failure is non-fatal — npm skips the failed package and the install completes. The site is prebuilt locally (see scripts/build.mjs + committed client/dist), so the platform never needs these. Locally they install normally, so builds are unaffected.
